note: Alberta Parks recreation area campground 13 km east of Nordegg on Hwy 11, treed, beside Shunda Creek and a stocked trout pond; the Shunda Creek trailhead leads 10 km to the North Saskatchewan River. Sites 4-11 are small, for tents and vehicles. Sites 12-17 are OHV campsites on the Rail Trail. Alberta Parks: 'Access road is not suitable for large RV units.' Firewood is sold at the operator's store at Fish Lake, 13 km west. --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks page (updated May 29, 2026), tear sheet and Westward Bound page read: 17 unserviced FCFS sites C$24, season May 8 - Oct 4 (approximate season replaced), hand pump not potable, max stay 16 nights. Two drop-candidate flags: OHV Rail Trail sites 12-17 / OHV staging, and 'Access road is not suitable for large RV units.' Sites 4-11 small. Pin ~290 m off south of Hwy 11: move recommended.
flags: OHV DROP CANDIDATE: Alberta Parks page: 'In partnership with The Rail Trail initiative, Harlech PRA has created six campsites accessible to OHV's. Ride in and stay at campsites 12-17 or stage your OHV camp from this location.' Tear sheet: 'OHV Camping Permitted Sites 12-17', with the Rail Trail running past the campground on both sides of Hwy 11. Operator Westward Bound: amenities 'Hiking and ATV access', but restrictions 'No ATV use in the campground'. So it is advertised as an OHV staging point on the Rail Trail system (6 of 17 sites), not only a general campground with an OHV side. Reviewer to decide.
ROAD DROP CANDIDATE: Alberta Parks page, under the site table: 'Access road is not suitable for large RV units.' (no length given; a 23-ft rig may or may not count as large).
SMALL SITES: 'Sites 4 - 11 are small sites suitable for tents and vehicles.' That leaves sites 1-3 and the OHV sites 12-17 for trailers/RVs. No posted lengths (FCFS; not on the shop).
PHONE (stored empty): page 'Information: 1-855-721-3975' = Facility Operator Westward Bound Campgrounds ((855) 721-3975, info@westwardbound.ca). Recommend 855-721-3975.
WEBSITE: stored Alberta Parks camping page answered 200 and is this campground. Operator page https://www.westwardbound.ca/harlech-campground.htm (200) could be added.
SENIORS LINE: PRESENT ('This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.').
SEASON: 'Season: May 8 - Oct 4' (2026); stored approximate May-Oct replaced. FCFS, so no shop 'Closed through' date.

POLICY ROW: FCFS self-registration with the operator's 16-night maximum; the provincial:AB row's 90-day window, C$12 reservation fee and 10-night maximum do not apply here (fees.reservation_fee already 0).

PIN (52.50000,-115.91250) is ~120 m SOUTH of Hwy 11, ~290 m from Alberta Parks' directions point. Imagery (older) shows the day-use lot by the creek bridge north of the highway but the campground loop is not visible under canopy. Recommend the agency point 52.50226,-115.91460.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. Tear sheet: the nearest sites (1-3) are ~100 m east of Shunda Creek behind the day-use area; the operator's 'Camp beside Shunda Creek' is not supported by the map.
ADVISORIES: none listed. Westward Bound's check-in 4 pm, check-out 2 pm.
